īti: īti & Ītī (f.) [Sk. īti, of doubtful origin] ill, calamity, plague, distress, often combb. with & substituted for upaddava, cp. BSk. ītay" opadrava (attack of plague) Divy 119. <-> Sn 51; J I.27 (V.189); V.401 = upaddava; Nd1 381; Nd2 48, 636 (+ upaddava = santāpa); Miln 152, 274, 418. --anīti sound condition, health, safety A IV.238; Miln 323.
ītika: ītika (adj.) [fr. īti] connected or affected with ill or harm, only in neg. an°.
ītiha: ītiha a doublet of itiha, only found in neg. an°.
